chain.label: DC-8 elevator control tab attachment vulnerable to single-point disconnection
chain.trigger: the current DC-8 design does not preclude a catastrophic result from a disconnection or failure of the existing control tab crank fitting to pushrod attachment

chain.label: Failure to properly secure and inspect elevator control tab attachment bolt during D inspection
chain.trigger: the failure to properly secure and inspect the attachment bolt

chain.label: Right elevator control tab pushrod bolt not secured with nut/cotter pin
chain.trigger: the required castellated nut was either never installed, or it was improperly installed

caused_by.evidence: the bolt must have separated because it had not been properly secured

chain.label: Right elevator control tab pushrod separated in flight and jammed in extreme trailing-edge-down position during takeoff roll
chain.trigger: the right elevator control tab crank fitting contacted the disconnected pushrod, restricting that control tab's further TEU movement and leaving it in an extreme TED deflection

caused_by.evidence: the bolt connecting the right elevator control tab crank fitting to the pushrod migrated out of the fitting, allowing the control tab to disengage from its pushrod
the current DC-8 design does not preclude a catastrophic result from a disconnection or failure of the existing control tab crank fitting to pushrod attachment

chain.label: Uncommanded nose-up pitch and loss of pitch control during takeoff rotation and climb
chain.trigger: the airplane pitched from 0.2º ANU...to 5.3º ANU...the pitch continued to increase despite the forward movement of the control column

caused_by.evidence: despite the large nose-down forces the pilots applied to the control columns, the pilots were unable to overcome the effects of the restricted right elevator control tab

chain.label: Airplane impacted terrain in automobile salvage yard during attempted emergency return
chain.trigger: The airplane impacted the ground in a left-wing-low, slightly nose-up attitude in an automobile salvage yard

caused_by.evidence: the pilots were unable to overcome the effects of the restricted right elevator control tab

chain.label: Three flight crewmembers killed
chain.trigger: The three flight crewmembers were killed, and the airplane was destroyed.

caused_by.evidence: the captain and flight engineer died as a result of thermal and traumatic injuries, and the first officer died of thermal injuries and inhalation of combustion products
